programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: Always and Forever
programme.desc: Former high-school sweethearts Grace and Michael (Rena Sofer and Dean McDermott) reconnect at their 20-year high-school reunion. Sparks fly, but the pair are hesitant to jump into a relationship that already failed once. Grace's mom (Barbara Eden), meanwhile, is quick to offer her two cents on her daughter's romantic woes. Max Gail and Rob Boltin also star. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: Love Finds a Home
programme.desc: Dr. Belinda Owens (Sarah Jones) cares for her pregnant friend, whose opinionated mother-in-law (Patty Duke) resists Belinda's scientific approach to medicine. Adding to Belinda's worries is her own desire, but seeming inability, to become pregnant. Haylie Duff and Jordan Bridges also star. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: Touched
programme.desc: A young nurse who takes a job as a live-in caretaker for a cantankerous, dying novelist discovers the secret of why the elderly woman is estranged from her son, and sets out to do something about it.

programme.title: Same Time Next Week
programme.desc: When Christy meets Charlie, they discover that they have a lot in common than their lost spouses.

programme.title: A Taste of Romance
programme.desc: A classically trained chef (Teri Polo) feels the heat of competition when a retired fireman (James Patrick Stuart) opens a restaurant next to hers. Though they clash initially, the pair soon strike up a friendship with help from the man's precocious daughter (Bailee Madison). Directed by Lee Rose.

programme.title: Decoration Day
programme.desc: James Garner stars as a retired judge whose cantankerous attitude is tempered by a troubled godchild (Norm Skaggs), a black tenant farmer (Bill Cobbs) who refuses the Medal of Honor and a blossoming romance. Judith Ivey. Rowena: Ruby Dee. Michael Waring: Larry Fishburne. Loreen: Jo Anderson. Judge Wesley: Wallace Wilkinson. Adapted from the novella by John William Corrington.

programme.title: Mulligan
programme.desc: A kids-show actor (Ethan Erickson) and a single mom (Jennie Garth) butt heads after the two are in a car accident. But while dealing with the fallout from the crash, the pair begin to make a real connection. The actor's secrets, however, threaten to ruin the fledgling romance. David Burton Morris directed.

programme.title: Change of Heart
programme.desc: A TV producer decides to set a show at a bed and breakfast and bonds with the owner's son. But he becomes furious after learning one of her secrets.

programme.title: Mystery Girl
programme.desc: A man (Sean Patrick Flanery) sends secret-admirer e-mails to his crush (Christine Scott Bennett), but an e-mail-address mix-up causes the notes to go to the woman's lovelorn coworker (Brigid Brannagh) instead. And though the man and his crush start dating, he can't help but feel a connection with the woman he'd been e-mailing. Directed by Allison Anders.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Wedding planner Abby specializes in fixing weddings that went wrong, but when she is forced to work with her ex-fiancé, she begins to question whether their relationship was the disaster she remembers.

programme.title: The Wish List
programme.desc: A perfectionist (Jennifer Esposito) makes a list of the qualities she's looking for in a mate and soon finds a seemingly ideal guy (Mark Deklin). programme.desc: Tori has always been one of the guys, but since her recent attempt to become more lady-like, she finds herself torn between a man who's fallen for her new femininity and a friend who loves her for the tomboy she's always been.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's blockbuster adventure, starring Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum and Richard Attenborough. Billionaire tycoon John Hammond has built the ultimate theme park - an island populated by genetically engineered dinosaurs. A group of guests, including Hammond's grandchildren, are invited to preview the attraction, touring the park in remotely controlled cars. But, as a tropical storm gathers, an unscrupulous employee shuts down the elaborate security system, leaving the tour stranded - and mayhem about to break loose.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Decades on from the creation of Jurassic Park, a fully operational attraction filled with genetically engineered dinosaurs has been opened on the island. In need of a new attraction, the company behind the park creates an entirely new species - only for it to escape and terrorise the tourists. Action adventure sequel, starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard.
